propositions: A single monolithic test iterating over 884 renderable units with ~1768 serial pandoc spawns takes 91.6s idle and 504.8s under CPU saturation, exceeding CI's 300s per-test timeout on the macOS py3.13 cell
pytest-timeout with --timeout-method=thread calls os._exit(1) from a timer thread, killing the xdist worker process without traceback or assertion text when the per-test budget is exceeded
The test must be chunk-parametrized with a fixed-size constant _EQUIVALENCE_CHUNK to bound per-test cost independent of corpus growth and system load
A coverage guard test must verify that all parametrized chunks reassemble to exactly _renderable_units() and total >= 100, ensuring no units are silently dropped
The fix preserves byte-identity verification by keeping _EQUIVALENCE_STRIDE at 1 and running real pandoc on both _convert and _legacy_convert paths for every unit
